hindi: न, बिना — शब्द को उलटने वाला निषेध (अज्ञान, अनंत)
definition: a negating prefix, written अन् before vowels, which turns knowledge into ignorance and end into endless; a cousin of English un- and the Greek a- in atom
example: अज्ञानम् इति पदे अ- ज्ञानस्य अभावं सूचयति। — In ajñānam, a- signals the lack of knowledge.

hindi: हिस्सा — नाटक का अंक; हिंदी में नंबर और गोद भी
definition: a mark, sign or numeral, the lap, and an act of a play, which is why Hindi अंक means both marks on a test and an act on stage (masculine)
example: प्रथमे अंके नायकः वनम् गच्छति। — In the first act, the hero goes to the forest.

hindi: आँख — देखने की इंद्रिय
definition: the eye, a neuter noun whose kṣ cluster Hindi turned into kh, giving आँख; Latin oculus and English eye are cousins (neuter i-stem)
example: बालकस्य अक्षि रक्तम् अस्ति। — The boy's eye is red.

hindi: आग — जलने की लपट और ताप
definition: fire, the everyday blaze of hearth and lamp, which Hindi wore down to आग; Latin ignis and English ignite are its cousins (masculine i-stem)
example: अग्निः गृहे ज्वलति। — The fire burns in the house.

hindi: मेहमान — घर आया हुआ आगंतुक
definition: a guest, traditionally explained as one whose visit keeps no fixed date (अ-, without, + तिथि, lunar day); India's tourism slogan अतिथिदेवो भव asks that the guest be treated as a god
example: अतिथिः गृहम् आगच्छति, माता जलम् आनयति। — A guest comes to the house and mother brings water.

hindi: मेहमान भगवान जैसा है — पर्यटन मंत्रालय का अभियान
definition: the Ministry of Tourism campaign asking Indians to treat visitors well, literally be one whose god is the guest; अतिथि is traditionally parsed as someone arriving without a fixed date (अ-, without + तिथि, lunar date; भव, be)
example: होटले अतिथिदेवो भव इति लिखितम्। — At the hotel is written: treat the guest as god.

hindi: अँधेरा — रोशनी का न होना
definition: darkness, literally the making of blindness, which Hindi wore down to अँधेरा, the familiar word for an unlit room (masculine a-stem)
example: रात्रौ अंधकारः भवति। — At night there is darkness.

hindi: ऊपर — ऊपर होने या अधिकार का भाव (अधिकार, अधिकारी)
definition: a prefix meaning over or above, sitting inside the Hindi words for right, officer and session, all things that stand over others
example: अधिकारी इति पदे अधि- उपरि स्थितिं दर्शयति। — In adhikārī, adhi- shows a position above others.

hindi: निरीक्षक — आँखों देखा गवाह, देख-रेख करने वाला; हिंदी में अब सभापति
definition: an eyewitness or overseer, literally one over the eye, a superintendent of treasury or stores, whom Hindi promoted to chairman and president (masculine noun, from अधि- and अक्ष, eye)
example: कोशस्य अध्यक्षः धनं गणयति — The superintendent of the treasury counts the money.

hindi: पीछे-पीछे — बाद में या अनुसार चलने का भाव (अनुवाद, अनुसार)
definition: a prefix meaning after or following along, which is why the Hindi word for translation, anuvād, literally means speaking again after another
example: अनुवादः इति पदे अनु- पश्चात् वदनं सूचयति। — In anuvāda, anu- signals speaking after someone.

hindi: दूर, उलटा — हटने या बिगड़ने का भाव (अपमान, अपशब्द)
definition: a prefix meaning away or down, which in Hindi mostly sours a word, turning honour into insult and speech into abuse; a cousin of Greek apo and English off
example: अपमानः इति पदे अप- मानं दूरं नयति। — In the word apamāna, apa- takes honour away.

hindi: की ओर — सामने या किसी की तरफ़ बढ़ने का भाव (अभिनय, अभिवादन)
definition: a prefix meaning toward or facing, found in the Hindi words for acting, campaign and greeting, each a movement aimed at someone
example: अभिमुखः इति पदे अभि- सम्मुखं गमनं दर्शयति। — In abhimukha, abhi- shows turning to face something.

hindi: अमावस — बिना चाँद की अंधेरी रात
definition: the night of the new moon, literally the dwelling-together, when sun and moon were pictured sharing one house in the sky (from अमा, together, and √वस्, to dwell; feminine)
example: अमावस्या रात्रौ चंद्रः न दृश्यते। — On the new-moon night the moon is not seen.

hindi: गहना — शरीर का आभूषण भी, भाषा की सजावट भी
definition: an ornament or piece of jewellery, and by extension a figure of speech that decorates a sentence, such as simile or pun (masculine, from अलम् + √कृ, to make sufficient)
example: उपमा कवीनाम् प्रियः अलंकारः अस्ति। — Simile is the poets' favourite ornament.

hindi: नीचे — उतरने या घटने का भाव (अवतार, अवगुण)
definition: a prefix meaning down or away, so an avatar is literally a crossing down and a vice is a quality brought low (अवतार from √तॄ, to cross)
example: अवतारः इति पदे अव- अधः आगमनं सूचयति। — In avatāra, ava- signals a coming down.

hindi: जगह — खाली स्थान, मौका या अंतराल; हिंदी में अब छुट्टी
definition: space or room, an opening or interval, and so an opportunity, which Hindi narrowed to a holiday or leave from work (masculine noun)
example: वृक्षयोः मध्ये अवकाशः नास्ति — There is no space between the two trees.

hindi: अविकारी शब्द — जो कभी रूप नहीं बदलता (च, अपि, इति)
definition: an indeclinable word that never changes form for case, number or gender, literally unspent, from the same stock as the Hindi word for expense
example: च अपि इति इत्यादि शब्दाः अव्यय भवन्ति। — Words like ca, api and iti are indeclinables.

hindi: आँसू — आँख से गिरती बूँद
definition: a tear, which Hindi nasalised into आँसू; English tear and Greek dakru are usually counted as distant cousins (neuter u-stem)
example: बालिकायाः अश्रु पतति। — The girl's tear falls.

hindi: घोड़ा — सवारी का पशु
definition: horse; a cousin of Latin equus and Greek hippos, so English equine, equestrian and hippopotamus, the river horse, all belong to its family
example: अश्वः वेगेन धावति — The horse runs fast.

hindi: आठ — सात और एक
definition: eight; a cousin of English eight and Latin octo, hiding inside October, octave and the eight-armed octopus (stem अष्टन्)
example: अष्ट बालकाः क्रीडन्ति — Eight boys are playing.

hindi: दिन-रात सेवा में — भारतीय डाक का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of India Post, meaning we serve day and night; अहर्निशम् fuses अहः, day, with निशा, night, the word behind Hindi निशा and निशाचर (सेवामहे, we serve, from √सेव्)
example: डाकघरे अहर्निशं सेवामहे इति लिखितम्। — At the post office is written: we serve day and night.

hindi: दर्पण — आईना और पांडुलिपि की प्रति; हिंदी में अब नैतिक आदर्श
definition: a mirror, and also a model copy of a manuscript, the image one looks into, which Hindi lifted into a moral ideal (masculine noun, from आ- and √दृश्, to see)
example: सा आदर्शे मुखं पश्यति — She looks at her face in the mirror.

hindi: झूलना — इधर-उधर हिलना, डोलना; हिंदी में अब जन-आंदोलन
definition: swinging or oscillating to and fro, a trembling motion like a swing, which Hindi made the political movement and public agitation (neuter noun, cousins with दोला, swing)
example: बालः दोलायाम् आंदोलनं करोति — The child swings to and fro on the swing.

hindi: आरती — दीप घुमाकर की जाने वाली उपासना
definition: in Hindu worship, the waving of lamps in circles before a deity, tied by name to night (रात्रि); Hindi wore आरात्रिक down to आरती
example: संध्याकाले भक्ताः आरात्रिकम् कुर्वन्ति। — In the evening the devotees perform the lamp-waving.

hindi: अदरक — तीखी गंध वाली जड़
definition: fresh ginger, literally the wet one as against dried ginger, which Hindi wore down to अदरक (neuter a-stem; from आर्द्र, wet)
example: माता भोजने आर्द्रकं योजयति। — Mother adds ginger to the food.

hindi: ऐसा — उद्धरण का चिह्न; हिंदी में इति का अर्थ अब समाप्ति
definition: thus, so, the particle that closes quoted speech or thought like a quotation mark, which Hindi read at the end of texts and took to mean the end
example: सः अहं गच्छामि इति वदति — He says, 'I am going.'

hindi: सूर्य का उत्तर-गमन — जाड़े के बाद सूर्य की उत्तर की ओर यात्रा
definition: the sun's apparent northward course after the winter solstice, from उत्तर, north, and अयन, path; Gujarat names its January kite festival after it (neuter)
example: उत्तरायण काले दिनानि दीर्घाणि भवन्ति। — During the northward course the days grow long.

hindi: अपशकुन — उछाल, अचानक अनोखी घटना; हिंदी में अब ऊधम
definition: flying up or a sudden leap, and any startling unusual event taken as a portent, which Hindi turned into mischief and havoc (masculine noun, from उद्- and √पत्, to fly)
example: आकाशे उत्पाताः दृश्यन्ते — Strange portents are seen in the sky.

hindi: खोलना — ताला या ढक्कन खोलना; हिंदी में अब फीता काटकर शुभारंभ
definition: opening, unlocking or uncovering something shut, an everyday household action that Hindi turned into a ribbon-cutting inauguration ceremony (neuter noun, from उद्- and √घट्)
example: सेवकः द्वारस्य उद्घाटनं करोति — The servant unlocks the door.

hindi: परिश्रम — कमर कसकर जुटना, प्रयास; हिंदी में अब इंडस्ट्री
definition: exertion, active effort or setting oneself to a task, which Hindi borrowed to name manufacturing and industry (masculine noun, from उद्- and √युज्)
example: कृषकः क्षेत्रे महान्तम् उद्योगं करोति — The farmer puts great effort into the field.

hindi: पास, छोटा — निकट या एक दर्जा नीचे होने का भाव (उपवन, उपमंत्री)
definition: a prefix meaning near or under, which makes a grove a lesser forest and a deputy minister one rank below; a cousin of Greek hypo
example: उपवनम् इति पदे उप- लघुं वनं सूचयति। — In upavanam, upa- marks a small garden-forest.

hindi: प्रस्ताव — पास रखना, सुझाव या भूमिका; हिंदी में अब नॉवेल
definition: placing something near, hence a statement, proposal, suggestion or introductory remark; the modern sense of a novel is a nineteenth-century coinage (masculine noun, from उप- and √अस्, to throw)
example: मंत्री राज्ञः पुरतः उपन्यासं करोति — The minister lays a proposal before the king.

hindi: तुलना — किसी को किसी जैसा बताना; अनुपम यानी बेजोड़
definition: a simile, a comparison that sets one thing beside another to measure it, the same measuring root found in Hindi अनुपम and a cousin of English measure (feminine, from उप + √मा, to measure)
example: मुखम् चंद्रः इव इति एषा उपमा। — 'A face like the moon' is a simile.

hindi: शब्द-पूर्व अंश — धातु के आगे जुड़कर अर्थ मोड़ने वाला टुकड़ा
definition: a prefix placed before a verbal root to bend its meaning, so a single root can yield the words for victory, defeat and triumph (from उप- + √सृज्, to release)
example: विजयः इति पदे वि इति उपसर्ग अस्ति। — The word vijaya, victory, carries the prefix vi.

hindi: ओझा — झाड़-फूँक करने वाला
definition: a teacher, one beside whom the student studies; Hindi wore it down to ओझा, now an exorcist, and to the surname झा (masculine a-stem)
example: उपाध्यायः छात्रान् पाठयति। — The teacher teaches the students.

hindi: ऊँट — रेगिस्तान का लंबी गर्दन वाला पशु
definition: the camel, whose heavy ṣṭr cluster Hindi flattened into a nasal vowel and ṭ, giving ऊँट (masculine a-stem)
example: उष्ट्रः मरुस्थले चलति। — The camel walks in the desert.

hindi: रुत — मौसम, साल के छह हिस्सों में से एक
definition: a season, one of the six two-month divisions of the Indian year; Hindi keeps the learned ऋतु beside the folk form रुत, heard in songs about the rains (masculine)
example: वसंतः प्रथमः ऋतुः अस्ति। — Spring is the first season.

hindi: काजल — आँखों में लगाने का काला लेप
definition: lampblack used as eye cosmetic, whose double consonant Hindi relaxed into काजल, the kohl lining many Indian eyes (neuter a-stem)
example: बालिका कज्जलं धारयति। — The girl wears kohl.

hindi: कहानी — कहने से बनी; कथावाचक आज भी सुनाते हैं
definition: a story or tale told aloud, from the root meaning to tell, the line that runs through Prakrit into Hindi कहना and कहानी (feminine, from √कथ्, to tell)
example: पितामही रात्रौ कथाम् कथयति। — Grandmother tells a story at night.

hindi: कौड़ी — छोटी सीप जो कभी पैसा थी
definition: a cowrie shell once used as small change, which Hindi wore down to कौड़ी, surviving in phrases about worthless things (feminine ā-stem)
example: वणिक् कपर्दिकां गणयति। — The merchant counts the cowrie shells.

hindi: कान — सुनने की इंद्रिय
definition: the ear, the organ of hearing, which survives in Hindi speech as कान and in geometry as कर्ण, the hypotenuse (masculine a-stem)
example: कर्णः शब्दं शृणोति। — The ear hears the sound.

hindi: कपास — रुई देने वाला पौधा
definition: the cotton plant and its fibre, which Hindi turned into कपास; ancient Greek borrowed the same word as karpasos for fine linen (masculine a-stem)
example: कर्पासात् वस्त्रं निर्मीयते। — Cloth is made from cotton.

hindi: काम — किया जाने वाला कार्य
definition: an act, deed or piece of work in the ordinary sense, which Hindi wore down to काम, the plain word for a job (neuter; stem कर्मन्, from √कृ, to do)
example: अद्य कर्म बहु अस्ति। — Today there is a lot of work.

hindi: शायर — कविता रचने वाला; पुराने अर्थ में ज्ञानी ऋषि
definition: in Vedic usage a wise seer who perceives hidden truths, and only in later classical usage a poet who composes verse (masculine i-stem)
example: अयम् कविः मधुरम् काव्यम् रचयति। — This poet composes sweet poetry.

hindi: कविता — कवि की रचना, चाहे गद्य हो या पद्य
definition: literary art as a whole, the work of a poet, which classical critics extended even to ornate prose romances like Kadambari (neuter, from कवि, poet)
example: बाणस्य कादंबरी गद्यम् अपि काव्यम् अस्ति। — Bana's Kadambari is prose, yet it is still poetry.

hindi: कुम्हार — मिट्टी के बर्तन बनाने वाला
definition: a potter, literally the pot-maker, whose compound Hindi wore down to कुम्हार, still the common name for the craft (masculine a-stem)
example: कुंभकारः चक्रेण घटं करोति। — The potter makes a pot with the wheel.

hindi: सकुशल — भला-चंगा, और काम में निपुण
definition: both well and skilful, traditionally explained as 'one who cuts कुश grass' without getting cut; Hindi keeps both senses, in कुशल-मंगल for health and कुशल कारीगर for skill
example: मित्र, गृहे सर्वे कुशलाः सन्ति वा? — Friend, is everyone at home well?

hindi: खेत — फ़सल उगाने की ज़मीन
definition: a field or tract of land, which Hindi wore down to खेत for farmland while keeping क्षेत्र for an abstract area or region (neuter a-stem)
example: कृषकः क्षेत्रे कार्यं करोति। — The farmer works in the field.

hindi: खोज — शब्दशः गायों की तलाश; हिंदी में अब अकादमिक शोध
definition: search or inquiry, built from गो, cow, and एषणा, seeking, so the scholar's research began as herders hunting for strayed cattle (feminine noun)
example: बालः नष्टस्य वत्सस्य गवेषणां करोति — The boy searches for the lost calf.

hindi: घर — रहने की जगह
definition: a house or dwelling, whose ṛ vowel and initial sound Hindi reshaped until it became घर, the most ordinary word for home (neuter a-stem)
example: मम गृहं ग्रामे अस्ति। — My house is in the village.

hindi: गेहूँ — रोटी का मुख्य अनाज
definition: wheat, a grain whose four syllables Hindi slowly shrank and nasalised until only गेहूँ was left (masculine a-stem)
example: कृषकः गोधूमं वपति। — The farmer sows wheat.

hindi: सभा — मिल-बैठकर बातचीत, गोष्ठ यानी गौशाला से; हिंदी में अब सेमिनार
definition: a gathering or assembly for conversation, built on गोष्ठ, the cow-pen where herders met, which Hindi dressed up as the academic seminar (feminine noun)
example: सायं ग्रामे गोष्ठी भवति — In the evening there is a gathering in the village.

hindi: गाय — दूध देने वाला पशु
definition: cow, and by extension cattle or earth; a cousin of English cow and Latin bos, behind bovine and beef (stem गो)
example: गौः क्षेत्रे तृणं खादति — The cow eats grass in the field.

hindi: गाँव — छोटी बस्ती
definition: a village or settlement of families, whose nasal and long vowel Hindi kept while dropping the cluster, leaving गाँव (masculine a-stem)
example: ग्रामः नद्याः तीरे अस्ति। — The village is on the bank of the river.

hindi: गर्मी — जेठ-आषाढ़ की तपती ऋतु; स्कूल का ग्रीष्मावकाश इसी से
definition: the hot season of Jyeshtha and Ashadha before the rains arrive; in Hindi it lives on mostly in formal compounds such as ग्रीष्मावकाश, the school summer vacation (masculine)
example: ग्रीष्म काले सूर्यः तीव्रः भवति। — In summer the sun becomes fierce.

hindi: घी — तपाकर साफ़ किया मक्खन
definition: clarified butter, literally that which has been sprinkled, which Hindi wore down to the two-letter घी (neuter a-stem)
example: माता भोजने घृतं योजयति। — Mother adds ghee to the food.

hindi: चाक — कुम्हार का घूमता पहिया
definition: a wheel or disc, which Hindi wore down to चाक, the potter's wheel; Greek kyklos, behind English cycle, is a cousin (neuter a-stem)
example: रथस्य चक्रं भ्रमति। — The chariot's wheel turns.

hindi: चाँद — रात का चमकता उपग्रह
definition: the moon, literally the shining one, which Hindi softened into चाँद, keeping the nasal as a nasalised vowel (masculine a-stem)
example: चंद्रः रात्रौ प्रकाशते। — The moon shines at night.

hindi: विस्मय — कविता का आनंददायक, चकित करने वाला सौंदर्य; हिंदी में अब करिश्मा
definition: astonishment and delight, the striking charm critics prized in poetry, which Hindi turned into a supernatural miracle or magic trick (masculine noun)
example: काव्यस्य चमत्कारः सहृदयान् मोदयति — A poem's charm delights sensitive readers.

hindi: लय — कविता की नपी हुई चाल; स्वच्छंद यानी मनमाना
definition: the metre of a verse, counted in syllables or beats, from a root meaning to please that survives in Hindi स्वच्छंद, free to follow one's own will (छंदस्, neuter)
example: अस्य पद्यस्य छंदः अनुष्टुप् अस्ति। — The metre of this verse is anushtubh.

hindi: जीभ — स्वाद लेने वाला अंग
definition: the tongue, whose awkward hv cluster Hindi simplified until only जीभ remained, a word every child knows (feminine ā-stem)
example: जिह्वा मधुरं रसं जानाति। — The tongue knows a sweet taste.

hindi: ज्ञान ही परम लक्ष्य है — आईआईटी बॉम्बे का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of IIT Bombay, meaning knowledge is the supreme goal; ध्येयम् is literally what should be meditated upon, which Hindi keeps as ध्येय, aim (from √ध्यै, to contemplate, the root of ध्यान)
example: विद्यालये ज्ञानं परमं ध्येयम् इति वदन्ति। — At the institute they say: knowledge is the supreme goal.

hindi: ऐसा ही हो — वरदान देते समय का वाक्य
definition: 'so be it', the formula spoken when granting a wish or blessing; its अस्तु is a cousin of English is (तथा, thus, + अस्तु, let it be, from √अस्, to be)
example: गुरुः शिष्यस्य प्रार्थनाम् श्रुत्वा तथास्तु इति वदति। — Hearing the pupil's request, the teacher says so be it.

hindi: तारीख — पंचांग का चंद्र-दिन, किसी भी काम की तय तिथि
definition: a lunar day, one thirtieth of the moon's monthly cycle, which can begin at any hour of the solar day; Hindi uses it for any date, and अतिथि, guest, is traditionally explained as one who arrives without a fixed date (feminine)
example: अद्य का तिथिः अस्ति? — Which lunar day is it today?

hindi: घाट — नदी पार करने या उतरने की जगह; हिंदी में अब तीर्थस्थान
definition: a ford or crossing place, a landing or bathing spot on a river, before it became the pilgrimage site Hindi knows (neuter noun, from √तॄ, to cross)
example: जनाः नद्याः तीर्थे स्नान्ति — People bathe at the river's ford.

hindi: तेल — चिकना तरल पदार्थ
definition: oil, literally the stuff of sesame, from तिल; Hindi wore it to तेल and now uses it for any oil, even petrol (neuter a-stem)
example: दीपे तैलम् अस्ति। — There is oil in the lamp.

hindi: तीन — दो और एक
definition: three, the form used inside compounds like त्रिकोण and त्रिशूल; a cousin of English three, Latin tres and trio (stem; nominative masculine त्रयः)
example: त्रिकोणे त्रयः कोणाः सन्ति — A triangle has three angles.

hindi: पंडित की भेंट — पूजा के बाद पुरोहित को दिया शुल्क
definition: in Hindu ritual, the fee given to the officiating priest, in Vedic times often a cow; related to दक्षिण, right-hand and south, a cousin of Latin dexter and English dexterity
example: यजमानः पुरोहिताय दक्षिणाम् ददाति। — The patron gives the priest his fee.

hindi: दाँत — भोजन चबाने वाला मुँह का अंग
definition: a tooth, which Hindi turned into दाँत; Latin dens, whence English dental, is a cousin (masculine a-stem)
example: बालकस्य दंतः श्वेतः अस्ति। — The child's tooth is white.

hindi: दस — नौ और एक
definition: ten; a cousin of English ten and Latin decem, the root of decimal, decade and December, once the tenth month (stem दशन्)
example: मम हस्तयोः दश अंगुलयः सन्ति — My hands have ten fingers.

hindi: भेंट — धर्म-भाव से दिया गया धन या वस्तु
definition: the act of giving, especially a gift made without expecting return (from √दा, to give); a cousin of Latin donum, which gave English donate and donor
example: धनिकः निर्धनाय अन्नस्य दानम् ददाति। — The rich man gives a gift of food to the poor man.

hindi: दिन — सूर्योदय से सूर्यास्त तक का समय
definition: a day, the bright span from sunrise to sunset; Hindi reserves it for named days such as स्वतंत्रता दिवस, and it is a cousin of Latin dies, day (masculine)
example: दिवसे सूर्यः प्रकाशते, रात्रौ चंद्रः। — By day the sun shines, by night the moon.

hindi: दीक्षांत — पढ़ाई पूरी होने का उपाधि-समारोह
definition: in Hindu ritual, consecration or initiation into a vow or a teacher's line (from √दीक्ष्, to consecrate); Indian universities call graduation day दीक्षांत, the end of initiation
example: शिष्यः गुरोः दीक्षाम् गृह्णाति। — The pupil receives initiation from the teacher.

hindi: दूध — गाय-भैंस का पेय
definition: milk, literally that which has been milked, a past participle that Hindi shortened to the plain household word दूध (from √दुह्, to milk)
example: माता बालाय दुग्धं ददाति। — The mother gives milk to the child.

hindi: बुरा, कठिन — बिगड़े या मुश्किल होने का भाव (दुर्घटना, दुर्लभ)
definition: a prefix meaning bad or hard, which makes an accident a bad happening and a rarity something hard to get; a cousin of the Greek dys in dysfunction
example: दुर्लभः इति पदे दुर्- काठिन्यं सूचयति। — In durlabha, dur- signals difficulty: hard to obtain.

hindi: बेटी — पुत्री, लड़की
definition: daughter; a close cousin of English daughter, German Tochter and Greek thugatēr, one of the clearest family matches across languages (stem दुहितृ)
example: राज्ञः दुहिता उद्याने क्रीडति — The king's daughter plays in the garden.

hindi: बारह — ग्यारह के बाद की संख्या
definition: twelve, literally two and ten, which Hindi wore down to बारह; Latin duodecim, behind English dozen, is a cousin
example: वर्षे द्वादश मासाः भवन्ति। — There are twelve months in a year.

hindi: दरवाज़ा — घर का प्रवेश
definition: door or gateway; a cousin of English door and Greek thura, and Persian dar, which gave Hindi दरवाज़ा
example: गृहस्य द्वारम् उद्घाटय — Open the door of the house.

hindi: धनवान — धन लाने वाला, समृद्ध; हिंदी में अब कृतार्थ, धन्यवाद में
definition: wealthy or bringing wealth, built on धन, riches, before fortunate and blessed took over, the sense Hindi keeps in धन्यवाद, thanks
example: धन्यः वणिक् बहु दानं ददाति — The wealthy merchant gives much in charity.

hindi: शुक्रिया — किसी के प्रति आभार के शब्द
definition: older Sanskrit used it for praise or applause, literally 'calling someone fortunate' (धन्य, blessed, + वाद, speech); modern Hindi narrowed it to plain thanks
example: साहाय्याय भवते धन्यवादः। — Thank you for your help.

hindi: जो धर्म की रक्षा करे, धर्म उसकी रक्षा करता है — रॉ का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of R&AW, India's external intelligence agency, meaning dharma protects those who protect it; one root appears twice, active रक्षति protects and passive रक्षितः protected (from √रक्ष्, to protect)
example: गुप्तचराः धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः इति स्मरन्ति। — The agents remember: dharma protects its protectors.

hindi: मूल — क्रिया का मूल रूप; हिंदी में यही शब्द लोहा-ताँबा जैसी धातु के लिए
definition: a verbal root from which nouns and verbs grow, first meaning a basic element of the body or earth, which is how Hindi came to use it for metal (from √धा, to put)
example: गच्छति इति पदस्य धातु गम् अस्ति। — The root of gacchati, 'goes', is gam.

hindi: धुआँ — आग जलने पर उठने वाली गैस
definition: smoke or vapour; a cousin of Latin fumus, which gives English fume and fumigate, and the direct ancestor of Hindi धुआँ
example: रसोईगृहात् धूमः उत्तिष्ठति — Smoke rises from the kitchen.

hindi: तारा — रात का तारा; पंचांग में चंद्रमा का पड़ाव
definition: a star, and specifically one of the twenty-seven star groups the moon passes through in a month, long used as markers on the calendar; folk songs wear it down to नखत (neuter)
example: आकाशे बहूनि नक्षत्राणि दृश्यन्ते। — Many stars are seen in the sky.

hindi: नंगा — बिना कपड़ों का
definition: naked or bare; a cousin of English naked and Latin nudus, which gives nude, and the source of Hindi नंगा
example: शिशुः नग्नः जले क्रीडति — The baby plays naked in the water.

hindi: आकाश को शान से छुओ — भारतीय वायुसेना का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of the Indian Air Force, rendered touch the sky with glory; नभः is the sky of Hindi नभ and नभचर, and स्पृशम् touching shares its root with Hindi स्पर्श (from √स्पृश्, to touch; दीप्तम्, blazing)
example: वायुसेनायाः ध्येयवाक्यं नभः स्पृशं दीप्तम् अस्ति। — The air force's motto is 'touch the sky with glory'.

hindi: नमस्कार — हाथ जोड़कर किया जाने वाला अभिवादन
definition: the everyday greeting of joined palms, literally 'a bow to you' (नमस्, a bow, + ते, to you); that little ते is a cousin of English thee
example: अतिथिम् दृष्ट्वा बालः नमस्ते इति वदति। — Seeing the guest, the boy says namaste.

hindi: नया — नूतन, ताज़ा
definition: new or fresh; a cousin of English new and Latin novus, which gives novel, novice and renovate; the same form also means nine
example: नववर्षे वयं मिष्टान्नं खादामः — At the new year we eat sweets.

hindi: रंगमंच का खेल — मंच पर अभिनय; बोलचाल में दिखावा
definition: a play acted on stage, the work of the नट, the dancer-actor, and in everyday Hindi also a fuss or pretence, as in 'stop this drama' (neuter)
example: वयम् श्वः नाटकम् द्रक्ष्यामः। — We shall watch a play tomorrow.

hindi: मुख्य स्त्री पात्र — कथा की नायक-प्रेमिका; नेता इसी धातु से
definition: the heroine, literally a woman who leads, feminine of नायक, from the same leading root that gives Hindi नेता and नेतृत्व (from √नी, to lead)
example: शकुंतला अस्य नाटकस्य नायिका अस्ति। — Shakuntala is the heroine of this play.

hindi: नाक — सूँघने का अंग
definition: nose or nostril; a cousin of English nose and Latin nasus, which gives nasal, so नासिका and nostril are relatives
example: गजस्य नासा दीर्घा अस्ति — The elephant's nose is long.

hindi: नाक — साँस लेने और सूँघने का अंग
definition: the nose, which Hindi clipped to नाक; Latin nasus and English nose and nasal are cousins (feminine ā-stem)
example: नासिका गंधं जिघ्रति। — The nose smells the scent.

hindi: नींद — सोने की अवस्था
definition: sleep, whose dr cluster Hindi dissolved into a nasal vowel, leaving नींद, while निद्रा itself stays in formal Hindi (feminine ā-stem)
example: रात्रौ निद्रा आगच्छति। — Sleep comes at night.

hindi: बंधन — बाँधना, जकड़ना; हिंदी में अब लेख
definition: binding, fastening or tying down, and then a written composition bound together, which school Hindi turned into the student essay (masculine noun, from नि- and √बंध्)
example: पशोः रज्ज्वा निबंधः क्रियते — The animal is tied with a rope.

hindi: बिना — किसी चीज़ से रहित होने का भाव (निर्दोष, निर्मल)
definition: a prefix meaning out of or without, which builds the Hindi words for blameless, spotless and fearless by stripping away the noun that follows (also निस्, reshaped by sandhi)
example: निर्मलम् इति पदे निर्- मलस्य अभावं दर्शयति। — In nirmalam, nir- shows the absence of dirt.

hindi: परदे के पीछे — मंच के पीछे सजने की जगह; वेशभूषा
definition: costume and decoration, and the tiring room behind the curtain where actors dress and from which offstage voices speak (neuter)
example: नेपथ्ये कोलाहलः श्रूयते। — A clamour is heard from behind the curtain.

hindi: नाव — पानी पर चलने वाली नौका
definition: boat or ship; a cousin of Latin navis and Greek naus, the family behind navy, navigate and nautical
example: नौः नद्यां तरति — The boat floats on the river.

hindi: नाव — पानी पर चलने वाली सवारी
definition: a small boat, a diminutive of नौ, the ship; Hindi kept the plain stem as नाव, and Latin navis, behind English navy, is a cousin (feminine ā-stem)
example: नद्यां नौका चलति। — A boat moves on the river.

hindi: पक्का — पूरा तैयार, मज़बूत
definition: cooked or ripe, which Hindi wore down to पक्का and widened to firm or certain, reaching English as pukka (past participle of √पच्, to cook)
example: वृक्षे पक्वं फलम् अस्ति। — There is a ripe fruit on the tree.

hindi: पखवाड़ा — चाँद के बढ़ने या घटने के पंद्रह दिन
definition: literally a wing or side, hence each half of the lunar month, the bright शुक्ल and the dark कृष्ण; the same word gives Hindi पक्ष and विपक्ष, side and opposition, and the worn-down पखवाड़ा (masculine)
example: शुक्ल पक्षे चंद्रः प्रतिदिनं वर्धते। — In the bright fortnight the moon grows every day.

hindi: पत्ता — पेड़ का पत्ता या पक्षी का पंख; हिंदी में अब चिट्ठी
definition: a leaf of a tree or the wing feather of a bird, and later the palm leaf written on, which is how Hindi got its letter (neuter noun)
example: वृक्षस्य पत्राणि पतन्ति — The tree's leaves are falling.

hindi: छंदबद्ध रचना — गद्य के उलट; पद यानी पाँव
definition: verse as opposed to prose, literally something having feet, from पद, a foot or quarter of a verse, a cousin of English foot and pedal (neuter)
example: इदम् पद्यम्, तत् गद्यम्। — This is verse, that is prose.

hindi: चारों ओर — घेरने या पूरा होने का भाव (परिवार, परिक्रमा)
definition: a prefix meaning around or all over, so a family is the circle that surrounds you and a circuit is walking around; a cousin of the Greek peri in perimeter
example: परिक्रमा इति पदे परि- चतुर्दिक् गमनं सूचयति। — In parikramā, pari- signals walking all the way around.

hindi: पान — चबाने वाला सुगंधित पत्ता
definition: a leaf or feather, which Hindi wore down to पान, now the betel leaf in particular; English fern is a cousin (neuter a-stem)
example: वृक्षात् पर्णं पतति। — A leaf falls from the tree.

hindi: पलंग — सोने की बड़ी चारपाई
definition: a bed or couch, which Hindi wore down to पलंग; a related form reached English through Portuguese as palanquin (masculine a-stem)
example: पर्यंके राजा शेते। — The king sleeps on the couch.

hindi: बर्तन — पहला अर्थ; नाटक या कहानी में किरदार
definition: a cup, bowl or vessel, then a worthy recipient, and in drama an actor or character, the stage sense Hindi uses for any character in a story (neuter)
example: अस्मिन् नाटके दश पात्राणि संति। — There are ten characters in this play.

hindi: पाँव — पैर, चरण
definition: foot, also a quarter or a verse line; a cousin of English foot and Latin pes, behind pedal and pedestrian
example: सः पादेन कंदुकं ताडयति — He kicks the ball with his foot.

hindi: संप्रदाय — किसी भी पंथ का अनुयायी; हिंदी पाखंड में अब केवल ढोंग
definition: a religious sect or its follower, used neutrally in Ashoka's edicts for every faith, later a heretic outside the Vedic fold, and in Hindi पाखंड mere hypocrisy (masculine noun)
example: नगरे नाना पाषंडाः वसन्ति — Followers of many different sects live in the city.

hindi: पितर — स्वर्गीय पुरखे, पूर्वज
definition: father; a cousin of English father and Latin pater, which gives paternal and patron; Hindi पितर kept the word for departed ancestors (stem पितृ)
example: पिता क्षेत्रं गच्छति — Father goes to the field.

hindi: प्यास — पानी पीने की इच्छा
definition: thirst, literally the wish to drink, a desiderative noun that Hindi collapsed into प्यास (feminine; from √पा, to drink)
example: ग्रीष्मे पिपासा अधिका भवति। — In summer, thirst grows stronger.

hindi: पूरा — भरा हुआ, समूचा
definition: full, filled or complete; a cousin of English full and Latin plenus, the family behind plenty and plenary
example: घटः जलेन पूर्णः अस्ति — The pot is full of water.

hindi: पूनम — पूरे चाँद की रात
definition: the night of the full moon, which closes the bright fortnight; built on पूर्ण, full, and worn down in everyday Hindi to पूनम, while festivals like गुरु पूर्णिमा keep the long form (feminine)
example: पूर्णिमा रात्रौ चंद्रः पूर्णः दृश्यते। — On the full-moon night the moon appears whole.

hindi: पीठ — शरीर का पिछला भाग
definition: the back, and also the surface or page of a leaf; Hindi wore the body sense down to पीठ but kept पृष्ठ for a book page (neuter a-stem)
example: अश्वस्य पृष्ठे बालकः उपविशति। — The boy sits on the horse's back.

hindi: आगे — शब्द से पहले लगकर बढ़ने का भाव (प्रगति, प्रचार)
definition: a prefix meaning forward or onward, lending motion and force to the word it leads, as in progress and publicity; a cousin of Latin pro and English fore
example: प्रगतिः इति पदे प्र- अग्रगमनं सूचयति। — In the word pragati, pra- signals going forward.

hindi: हर, बदले में — हर एक या सामने का भाव (प्रतिदिन, प्रतिशत)
definition: a prefix meaning toward, against or each, which gives Hindi its words for daily, per cent, reflection and rival; a cousin of Greek pros
example: प्रतिदिनम् इति पदे प्रति- प्रत्येकं दिनं सूचयति। — In pratidinam, prati- means each and every day.

hindi: शब्दांत — धातु या शब्द के पीछे जुड़ने वाला अंश; मूल अर्थ भरोसा
definition: a suffix attached after a root or stem to make a new word, though in everyday Sanskrit the same word means trust or firm belief (from प्रति- + √इ, to go)
example: पाठकः इति पदे अक इति प्रत्यय अस्ति। — The word pāṭhaka, reader, ends in the suffix aka.

hindi: विस्तार — फैलाव और लंबा-चौड़ा वर्णन; हिंदी में अब छल-कपट
definition: expansion, development and diversity, and so wordy elaboration, which drifted towards deceit and became the scheming intrigue of Hindi (masculine noun)
example: अलं प्रपंचेन, संक्षेपेण वद — Enough elaboration, say it briefly.

hindi: रचना — लगातार जुड़ी हुई काव्य-कृति; हिंदी में अब इंतज़ाम या मैनेजमेंट
definition: an unbroken connection or continuous series, and so a sustained literary composition, before Hindi made it arrangement and business management (masculine noun, from प्र- and √बंध्, to bind)
example: कविः नवं प्रबंधं रचयति — The poet composes a new literary work.

hindi: निर्मलता — स्वच्छता, शांति और कृपा; हिंदी में अब मंदिर का भोग
definition: clearness, brightness and calm, as of autumn water or a pleased mind, hence favour and grace; in Hindu ritual, food returned as a blessing (masculine noun, from प्र- and √सद्)
example: शरदि नदीजलस्य प्रसादः भवति — In autumn river water grows clear.

hindi: पत्थर — कठोर चट्टान का टुकड़ा
definition: a stone or flat slab, literally something spread out, which Hindi wore down to पत्थर, the common word for any rock (masculine a-stem)
example: मार्गे प्रस्तरः अस्ति। — There is a stone on the path.

hindi: हँसी-नाटक — व्यंग्य भरा छोटा नाटक; हँसना इसी धातु से
definition: a one-act farce mocking rogues, false ascetics and courtesans, from the root of laughter that also gives Hindi हँसना and हँसी (neuter, from प्र + √हस्, to laugh)
example: प्रहसनम् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे हसंति। — Everyone laughs on seeing the farce.

hindi: सुबह — दिन का पहला पहर, सूर्योदय के आसपास
definition: early morning, the first part of the day around sunrise; Hindi keeps it in formal speech and in the school's प्रातःकालीन सभा, the morning assembly (from प्रातर्, at dawn, and काल, time; masculine)
example: प्रातःकाले पक्षिणः मधुरं गायन्ति। — In the early morning the birds sing sweetly.

hindi: याचना — माँगना, अनुरोध करना; हिंदी में अब ईश्वर-स्तुति
definition: asking, requesting or petitioning anyone for something, a beggar's plea as much as a suitor's, which Hindi narrowed to prayer (feminine noun, from प्र- and √अर्थ्)
example: याचकः धनस्य प्रार्थनां करोति — The beggar makes a request for money.

hindi: शक्ति की जड़ विज्ञान है — डीआरडीओ का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of DRDO, India's defence research organisation, meaning science is the root of strength; मूलम् is the root behind Hindi मूल and मूली, and विज्ञान meant discerning knowledge long before it meant laboratory science
example: प्रयोगशालायां बलस्य मूलं विज्ञानम् इति पठामः। — In the laboratory we read: science is the root of strength.

hindi: बहुतों के हित और सुख के लिए — आकाशवाणी का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of All India Radio, meaning for the welfare and happiness of the many; the ending -आय is the dative case meaning for, which Hindi now expresses with के लिए (बहु, many + जन, people + हित, good)
example: आकाशवाणी बहुजनहिताय बहुजनसुखाय प्रसारयति। — All India Radio broadcasts for the good and happiness of the many.

hindi: भूख — खाने की इच्छा
definition: hunger, literally the wish to eat, a desiderative noun that Hindi squeezed down to the short word भूख (feminine; from √भुज्, to eat)
example: बालकस्य बुभुक्षा अस्ति। — The boy is hungry.

hindi: बहन — एक ही माता-पिता की बेटी
definition: a sister, which Hindi wore down through spoken forms into बहन, the everyday word for a sister (feminine ī-stem)
example: मम भगिनी गीतं गायति। — My sister sings a song.

hindi: भीख — माँगकर मिली चीज़
definition: alms, food given to one who asks, which Hindi wore down to भीख and coloured with the sense of begging (feminine; from √भिक्ष्, to ask)
example: साधुः भिक्षां याचते। — The ascetic asks for alms.

hindi: भाई — एक ही माता-पिता का बेटा
definition: a brother, which Hindi wore down to भाई; English brother and Latin frater are cousins (masculine; stem भ्रातृ)
example: मम भ्राता विद्यालयं गच्छति। — My brother goes to school.

hindi: भौं — आँख के ऊपर के बाल
definition: eyebrow; a cousin of English brow and Greek ophrys, one of the oldest body words shared across the family
example: तस्याः भ्रूः वक्रा अस्ति — Her brow is arched.

hindi: शहद — मधुमक्खी का बनाया रस
definition: honey or anything sweet; a cousin of English mead, the old honey wine, and Greek methu, meaning wine
example: मधुमक्षिकाः मधु संचिन्वन्ति — Bees gather honey.

hindi: मँझला — बीच वाला (भाई या बच्चा)
definition: middle or central; a cousin of English mid and middle and Latin medius, behind medium and Mediterranean
example: ग्रामस्य मध्ये एकः कूपः अस्ति — There is a well in the middle of the village.

hindi: मोर — रंगीन पंखों वाला पक्षी
definition: the peacock, whose middle syllable Hindi swallowed, so that three syllables shrank to the single breath मोर (masculine a-stem)
example: मयूरः वर्षाकाले नृत्यति। — The peacock dances in the rainy season.

hindi: मिर्च — तीखा मसाला
definition: black pepper; Hindi wore it down to मिर्च and moved the name to the American chilli when it arrived in India (neuter a-stem)
example: मरिचं तीक्ष्णं भवति। — Pepper is pungent.

hindi: माँ — जन्म देने वाली स्त्री
definition: mother; a cousin of English mother, Latin mater and Greek mētēr, all sharing one ancient family word (stem मातृ)
example: मम माता गृहे अस्ति — My mother is at home.

hindi: मौसी — माँ की बहन
definition: a mother's sister, literally mother-sister, a long compound that Hindi wore down to the affectionate two-syllable मौसी (feminine; stem मातृष्वसृ)
example: मम मातृष्वसा नगरे वसति। — My mother's sister lives in the city.

hindi: महीना — एक चाँद से अगले चाँद तक का समय
definition: a month, measured from one new or full moon to the next; a cousin of English moon and month, and in older Sanskrit it can mean the moon itself (masculine)
example: चैत्र मासे वसंतः आरभते। — Spring begins in the month of Chaitra.

hindi: मुहर — मोहर वाली अँगूठी, छाप; हिंदी में अब करेंसी या भाव-भंगिमा
definition: a seal or signet ring and the impression it stamps, then a stamped coin, from which Hindi drew both currency and posture (feminine noun)
example: राजा पत्रे मुद्रां ददाति — The king sets his seal on the letter.

hindi: पल — एक क्षण या अड़तालीस मिनट; हिंदी में अब शुभ घड़ी
definition: a moment, and also a fixed unit of time, one thirtieth of a day or forty-eight minutes, which Hindi narrowed to an auspicious hour (masculine or neuter noun)
example: मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ, अहम् आगच्छामि — Wait a moment, I am coming.

hindi: जंगली पशु — कोई भी वन्य जीव; हिंदी में केवल हिरन, पर मृगराज यानी सिंह
definition: any wild forest animal or game beast, which is why the lion is called मृगराज, king of beasts, though Hindi narrowed it to deer (masculine noun)
example: वने बहवः मृगाः चरन्ति, सिंहः अपि — Many wild beasts roam the forest, the lion too.

hindi: जजमान — पुरोहित से पूजा करवाने वाला परिवार
definition: the patron who sponsors a sacrifice and pays the priests (from √यज्, to worship); worn down in Hindi to जजमान, the household a priest or barber traditionally serves
example: यजमानः पुरोहितम् गृहम् आह्वयति। — The patron invites the priest to his house.

hindi: जनेऊ — कंधे से पहना जाने वाला पवित्र धागा
definition: in Hindu ritual, the sacred cord worn over the left shoulder after the thread ceremony, literally 'the sacrificial covering'; everyday Hindi wore the long word down to जनेऊ
example: बालः अद्य प्रथमम् यज्ञोपवीतम् धारयति। — Today the boy wears the sacred thread for the first time.

hindi: जहाँ धर्म, वहाँ जीत — सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of the Supreme Court of India, meaning where righteousness stands, victory follows; sandhi hides four separate words, यतः where, धर्मः, ततः there, and जयः victory (यतः + धर्मः + ततः + जयः)
example: न्यायालये यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः इति पठामः। — In the court we read: where there is dharma, there is victory.

hindi: जुआ — बैलों के कंधे पर रखी लकड़ी
definition: yoke for a pair of draught animals, later a pair or an age of the world; a cousin of English yoke and Latin iugum (from √युज्, to join)
example: कृषकः वृषभयोः युगं स्थापयति — The farmer puts the yoke on the two bulls.

hindi: कर्म में कुशलता ही योग है — आईआईटी खड़गपुर का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of IIT Kharagpur, meaning yoga is skill in action; here योग means disciplined method rather than physical postures, and कौशलम्, skill, is built from कुशल, skilful, and survives in Hindi as कौशल (कर्मसु, in actions, locative plural of कर्मन्)
example: छात्राः योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् इति पठन्ति। — The students read: yoga is skill in action.

hindi: तुम्हारा भरण-पोषण मैं उठाता हूँ — एलआईसी का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of the Life Insurance Corporation of India, meaning I carry your welfare; योगक्षेम pairs gaining what you lack with keeping what you already have, a neat description of insurance (वहामि, I carry, from √वह् + अहम्, I)
example: बीमापत्रे योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् इति मुद्रितम्। — 'I carry your welfare' is printed on the insurance policy.

hindi: मंच — रंगमंच और रंगकर्मी में बचा पुराना अर्थ; आज रंग यानी वर्ण
definition: colour or dye, and also a stage, theatre or arena, the sense surviving in Hindi रंगमंच and रंगकर्मी while everyday रंग kept only colour (masculine)
example: नटाः रंगम् प्रविशंति। — The actors walk onto the stage.

hindi: स्वाद — रसिक और नीरस इसी से; नाटक में दर्शक का भाव-आनंद
definition: sap, juice or taste, and in the theory of drama the distilled emotional flavour, such as love or heroism, that an audience savours (masculine)
example: अस्मिन् नाटके करुणः रसः प्रधानः अस्ति। — Pathos is the dominant flavour in this play.

hindi: रात — सूर्यास्त से सूर्योदय तक का अंधेरा
definition: night, the span from sunset to sunrise; Hindi shortened it to रात, yet festivals still count by the full form, as in नवरात्रि, the nine nights (feminine)
example: रात्रि काले चंद्रः शोभते। — At night the moon looks lovely.

hindi: संख्या — एक, दो या अनेक; हिंदी में 'वचन देना' यानी वादा करना
definition: grammatical number, which Sanskrit counts three ways as singular, dual and plural; first meaning speech, it survives in Hindi as a promise (from √वच्, to speak; a cousin of English voice)
example: नेत्रे इति पदं द्वि वचन रूपम् अस्ति। — Netre, 'the two eyes', is a dual-number form.

hindi: बहू — बेटे की पत्नी
definition: a bride or young wife, which Hindi wore down to बहू, narrowing the sense to a son's wife in the household (feminine ū-stem)
example: वधूः गृहं प्रविशति। — The bride enters the house.

hindi: हम रक्षा करते हैं — भारतीय तटरक्षक बल का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of the Indian Coast Guard, meaning simply we protect; रक्षामः is the plain present tense of the verb whose root gives Hindi रक्षा, रक्षक and राखी (वयम्, we; from √रक्ष्, to protect)
example: तटरक्षकाः वदन्ति वयं रक्षामः इति। — The coast guards say, 'we protect'.

hindi: बत्ती — दीये की जलती डोरी
definition: the wick of a lamp, literally a little twisted thing, which Hindi wore down to बत्ती and stretched to any light or bulb (feminine ā-stem)
example: दीपे वर्तिका ज्वलति। — The wick burns in the lamp.

hindi: बरसात — सावन-भादों की बारिश वाली ऋतु
definition: rain, and the rainy season of Shravana and Bhadrapada; the same root gave वर्ष, year, because years were once counted in monsoons, and Hindi बरसना and बरसात descend from it (feminine)
example: वर्षा ऋतौ मयूराः नृत्यन्ति। — In the rainy season peacocks dance.

hindi: बसंत — चैत-बैसाख का फूलों वाला मौसम
definition: spring, the season of Chaitra and Vaishakha when mango trees flower and the koel sings; Hindi softened the opening sound to give बसंत, as in बसंत पंचमी (masculine)
example: वसंत ऋतौ कोकिलः मधुरं गायति। — In spring the cuckoo sings sweetly.

hindi: सारी धरती एक परिवार है — जी20 भारत 2023 का विषय-वाक्य
definition: the theme of India's 2023 G20 presidency, rendered One Earth, One Family, One Future; वसुधा is the earth as holder of wealth, and कुटुंबकम् is the family, the word Hindi keeps as कुटुंब (वसुधा + एव, indeed)
example: सम्मेलने वसुधैव कुटुंबकम् इति घोषः आसीत्। — At the summit the slogan was 'the whole world is one family'.

hindi: खबर — समाचार और आजीविका; हिंदी में अब बातचीत या समझौता-वार्ता
definition: news or tidings, and also livelihood through farming, cattle and trade, the old science of economics, before Hindi made it formal talks (feminine noun)
example: भो मित्र, ग्रामे का वार्ता — Friend, what news from the village?

hindi: अलग — अलगाव या विशेषता का भाव (वियोग, विदेश)
definition: a prefix meaning apart or away, which can split a word's sense, as in separation and foreign land, or sharpen it, as in special and science
example: वियोगः इति पदे वि- योगस्य विपरीतं करोति। — In viyoga, vi- turns union into separation.

hindi: रंग-बिरंगा — चितकबरा, अनेक प्रकार का; हिंदी में अब अजीब
definition: variegated, spotted or many-coloured, and so manifold and diverse, before Hindi settled on strange and bizarre (from वि- and चित्र, bright)
example: मयूरस्य पक्षाः विचित्राः — The peacock's feathers are many-coloured.

hindi: मसखरा — नाटक का हँसोड़, पेटू ब्राह्मण साथी
definition: the jester of Sanskrit drama, the hero's greedy Brahmin friend who speaks Prakrit rather than Sanskrit, literally one who spoils or defiles (masculine, from वि + √दुष्)
example: विदूषकः मोदकम् खादति, सर्वे हसंति। — The jester eats a sweet, and everyone laughs.

hindi: बिजली — आकाश की चमक या करंट
definition: lightning, literally that which flashes forth, which Hindi wore down to बिजली and then stretched to mean electric power (feminine consonant stem)
example: आकाशे विद्युत् द्योतते। — Lightning flashes in the sky.

hindi: कारक-चिह्न — नाम के अंत का बदलता रूप, जिसकी जगह हिंदी में ने, को, से आए
definition: a case ending added to a noun to show its role in the sentence, the work Hindi now hands to separate little words such as को and से (from वि- + √भज्, to divide)
example: रामेण इति पदे तृतीया विभक्ति अस्ति। — The form rāmeṇa, 'by Rama', carries the third case ending.

hindi: क्रीड़ा — खेल, लीला और लावण्य; हिंदी में अब ऐशो-आराम
definition: play, sport and graceful movement, the charm of a gesture or glance, which Hindi turned into luxury and self-indulgence (masculine noun)
example: बालानां विलासः मनोहरः — The children's play is charming.

hindi: अनुभूति — सुख-दुख का कोई भी अहसास; हिंदी में केवल पीड़ा
definition: perception or sensation of any kind, pleasant as well as painful, from √विद्, to know, which Hindi narrowed to pain and anguish (feminine noun)
example: सुखस्य अपि वेदना भवति — There is a feeling of pleasure too.

hindi: मुकदमा — कानूनी कार्यवाही और लेन-देन; हिंदी में अब बर्ताव
definition: dealings between people, especially trade and legal procedure, so that law books call a lawsuit व्यवहार, where Hindi hears mostly personal behaviour (masculine noun)
example: वणिक् न्यायसभायां व्यवहारं करोति — The merchant brings a lawsuit before the court.

hindi: भाषा-नियम — शब्दों और वाक्यों की बनावट समझाने वाला शास्त्र
definition: the study of how words are formed and joined, literally a taking apart, since grammarians split each word into root, prefix and ending (from वि- + आ- + √कृ, to make)
example: पाणिनिः व्याकरण शास्त्रस्य महान् आचार्यः आसीत्। — Pāṇini was the great master of grammar.

hindi: बाघ — धारीदार बड़ी बिल्ली
definition: the tiger, whose heavy initial cluster Hindi dropped, leaving only बाघ, the everyday name for the striped animal (masculine a-stem)
example: व्याघ्रः वने गर्जति। — The tiger roars in the forest.

hindi: उपवास — नियम से रखा गया धार्मिक अनशन
definition: in early Sanskrit a will, rule or solemn vow of any kind; in Hindu practice it narrowed to a religious observance, and in everyday Hindi usually means a fast
example: माता सोमवासरे व्रतम् करोति। — Mother keeps a fast on Mondays.

hindi: वरुण हमारे लिए मंगलकारी हों — भारतीय नौसेना का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of the Indian Navy, a short prayer that Varuna, lord of the waters, be gracious to us; शम् means welfare, the same word hidden inside Hindi शंकर, giver of good (शम्, welfare + नः, to us + वरुणः)
example: नौकायां शं नो वरुणः इति लिखितम्। — On the ship is written: may Varuna be kind to us.

hindi: सौ — दस का दस गुना
definition: a hundred; a cousin of Latin centum and English hundred, so cent, century and percent all belong to the same family
example: ग्रामे शतं गृहाणि सन्ति — The village has a hundred houses.

hindi: शरद — क्वार-कार्तिक की साफ़ आसमान वाली ऋतु, शरद पूर्णिमा वाली
definition: autumn, the clear-skied season of Ashvina and Kartika that follows the rains; old Sanskrit counted a lifetime in autumns, wishing someone a hundred of them (feminine consonant stem)
example: शरद् ऋतौ आकाशः निर्मलः भवति। — In autumn the sky becomes clear.

hindi: शक्कर — मीठे दाने वाली चीज़
definition: grit or gravel first, then crystalline sugar; Hindi wore it to शक्कर, and the same word travelled through Persian and Arabic to become English sugar (feminine ā-stem)
example: दुग्धे शर्करा मिश्रिता अस्ति। — Sugar is mixed in the milk.

hindi: कड़ाके की सर्दी — माघ-फागुन की ठिठुरन और ओस वाली ऋतु
definition: late winter, the dewy season of Magha and Phalguna; as an adjective it also means cool, which is why the moon could be called शिशिरकर, the cool-rayed one (masculine)
example: शिशिर ऋतौ वृक्षाणां पत्राणि पतन्ति। — In late winter the leaves of the trees fall.

hindi: सिख — सिख पंथ का अनुयायी
definition: a pupil or disciple, one to be taught; through Punjabi it was worn down to सिख, the name of the faith's followers (masculine a-stem)
example: शिष्यः गुरुं नमति। — The pupil bows to the teacher.

hindi: अच्छा — मंगलकारी, सौभाग्य लाने वाला
definition: auspicious or fortunate, though its older sense was bright and handsome (from √शुभ्, to shine); the same root gives Hindi शोभा, beauty, and lives on in शुभकामना
example: अद्य शुभम् दिनम् अस्ति, अतः वयम् यात्राम् आरभामहे। — Today is an auspicious day, so we begin the journey.

hindi: शुद्धि — साफ़ करना, सुधारना; हिंदी में अब रिसर्च
definition: purification or cleansing, correcting an error and paying off a debt, which Hindi turned into academic research (masculine noun, from √शुध्, to be pure)
example: सुवर्णस्य शोधः अग्निना भवति — Gold is purified by fire.

hindi: श्रीमान — नाम से पहले लगने वाला आदरसूचक
definition: radiance, beauty and prosperity, personified as the goddess of fortune; placed before names it became the Hindi courtesy title behind श्रीमान and श्रीमती
example: यत्र परिश्रमः अस्ति तत्र गृहे श्रीः वसति। — Prosperity lives in the house where there is hard work.

hindi: पद्य — दो पंक्तियों का छंद; वैदिक अर्थ में कीर्ति
definition: a couplet in the common epic metre of four eight-syllable quarters, though older Vedic usage meant sound, call and especially fame (masculine)
example: अयम् श्लोकः सरलः अस्ति। — This verse is simple.

hindi: ससुर — पति या पत्नी के पिता
definition: a father-in-law, which Hindi wore down to ससुर; Latin socer and old German swehur are cousins (masculine a-stem)
example: श्वशुरः गृहे आगच्छति। — The father-in-law comes home.

hindi: सास — पति या पत्नी की माँ
definition: a mother-in-law, which Hindi wore down to सास; Latin socrus, of the same meaning, is a cousin (feminine ū-stem)
example: श्वश्रूः वध्वा सह वसति। — The mother-in-law lives with the daughter-in-law.

hindi: प्रण — मन में ठाना हुआ पक्का इरादा
definition: in Hindu ritual, the spoken statement of intent made before a rite begins, naming time, place and purpose; Hindi stretched it to any firm resolution (from सम्, together, + √क्लृप्, to arrange)
example: सः प्रतिदिनम् पठितुम् संकल्पम् करोति। — He resolves to study every day.

hindi: सकरात — सूर्य का एक राशि से अगली में जाना; मकर संक्रांति का लोक-नाम
definition: the sun's passage from one zodiac sign into the next, literally a going-across; मकर संक्रांति marks the January crossing and is among the few Hindu festivals fixed by the sun rather than the moon (from सम् + √क्रम्, to step; feminine)
example: संक्रांति दिने जनाः तिलान् खादन्ति। — On sankranti day people eat sesame.

hindi: सच — जो वास्तव में है
definition: truth, the quality of what really is, which Hindi wore down to सच in speech while keeping सत्य for formal use (neuter a-stem)
example: सः सदा सत्यं वदति। — He always speaks the truth.

hindi: सत्य, कल्याणकारी और सुंदर — दूरदर्शन का आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the motto of Doordarshan, India's public television broadcaster, naming truth, goodness and beauty; शिवम् here is the ordinary adjective auspicious rather than the god's name, while सुंदरम् passed almost unchanged into Hindi सुंदर
example: दूरदर्शने सत्यं शिवं सुंदरम् इति दृश्यते। — On Doordarshan one sees 'truth, goodness, beauty'.

hindi: सच की ही जीत होती है — भारत का राष्ट्रीय आदर्श वाक्य
definition: the national motto of India, printed beneath the lion capital on banknotes, coins and passports, meaning truth alone conquers; जयते shares its root with Hindi जय and जीत (सत्यम्, truth + एव, alone; जयते from √जि, to conquer)
example: मुद्रायां सत्यमेव जयते इति लिखितम् अस्ति। — On the currency is written: truth alone triumphs.

hindi: मेल — ध्वनियों का जुड़ना; हिंदी में देशों का समझौता भी
definition: the joining of sounds where two words meet, so that final and initial sounds blend or change; in Hindi the same word also names a treaty between nations (from सम्- + √धा, to put)
example: संधि इति नियमात् देव आलयः इति पदं देवालयः भवति। — Through the rule called sandhi, deva ālaya becomes devālaya.

hindi: साँझ — दिन ढलने का समय
definition: twilight, the joining of day and night, which Hindi wore down to साँझ for evening; in Hindu ritual it also names the evening prayer (feminine ā-stem)
example: संध्यायां पक्षिणः नीडं गच्छन्ति। — At dusk, birds go to the nest.

hindi: साधक — काम पूरा करने वाला; हिंदी में अब अख़बार का मुखिया
definition: one who accomplishes, procures or brings something about, a fixer of tasks, whom Hindi made the newspaper editor (masculine noun, from सम्- and √पद्)
example: सः कार्यस्य संपादकः अस्ति — He is the one who gets the work done.

hindi: सात — छह और एक
definition: seven; a cousin of English seven and Latin septem, which named September when it was still the seventh Roman month (stem सप्तन्)
example: सप्ताहे सप्त दिनानि सन्ति — A week has seven days.

hindi: सभासद — सभा के योग्य, शिष्ट; हिंदी में अब सुसंस्कृत
definition: fit for an assembly, courteous in company, and as a noun a member of the assembly, built on सभा, the sense Hindi widened to civilized
example: सभायां सभ्याः उपविशन्ति — The members of the assembly sit in the hall.

hindi: आचरण — चाल-चलन और रीति; हिंदी में अब खबर
definition: conduct, behaviour and customary practice, how someone carries on, which slid into an account of their doings and so Hindi news (masculine noun, from सम्-, आ- and √चर्)
example: सज्जनानां समाचारः अनुकरणीयः — The conduct of good people is worth following.

hindi: जोड़ा शब्द — कई शब्दों को मिलाकर बना एक शब्द (राजपुत्र, नीलकमल)
definition: the joining of two or more words into one compound, dropping the endings between them, as king and son make prince (from सम्- + √अस्, to throw)
example: राज्ञः पुत्रः, समास इति विधिना, राजपुत्रः भवति। — The king's son, by compounding, becomes rājaputra.

hindi: साथ, पूरा — मिलकर या भली-भाँति का भाव (संगम, संपूर्ण)
definition: a prefix meaning together or completely, written as anusvara before most consonants, as in confluence and complete; a cousin of English same
example: संगमः इति पदे सम्- नद्योः मिलनं दर्शयति। — In the word saṅgama, sam- shows two rivers meeting.

hindi: साँप — रेंगने वाला ज़हरीला जीव
definition: a snake, literally the creeping one, which Hindi turned into साँप; Latin serpens and English serpent are cousins (masculine; from √सृप्, to creep)
example: सर्पः वने चलति। — The snake moves in the forest.

hindi: सरसों — तेल देने वाले पीले फूलों का दाना
definition: mustard seed, whose final syllable Hindi softened and nasalised into सरसों, the yellow crop of northern winters (masculine a-stem)
example: क्षेत्रे सर्षपः पुष्पितः अस्ति। — The mustard is in flower in the field.

hindi: संवत — एक पूरा वर्ष; विक्रम संवत इसी का छोटा रूप
definition: a full year, one complete round of the seasons; the संवत printed on Hindi wedding cards and calendars, as in Vikram Samvat, is this word cut short (masculine)
example: एकस्मिन् संवत्सरे द्वादश मासाः भवन्ति। — In one year there are twelve months.

hindi: परिष्कार — चमकाना, शुद्ध करना; हिंदी में अब परवरिश के मूल्य
definition: refining, polishing and perfecting, as of gems or speech, the same idea that names संस्कृत itself, later a lasting impression and a rite (masculine noun, from सम्- and √कृ)
example: मणेः संस्कारः शिल्पिना क्रियते — The gem's polishing is done by the craftsman.

hindi: दुस्साहस — मूल में उतावली हिंसा या डकैती; हिंदी में अब केवल हिम्मत
definition: a rash or violent deed, including robbery and assault in the law books, and the fine imposed for it, where Hindi now hears only courage (neuter noun)
example: चौरः रात्रौ साहसम् अकरोत् — The thief committed a violent robbery at night.

hindi: अच्छा — भलाई या आसानी का भाव (सुगंध, सुलभ)
definition: a prefix meaning good, well or easy, which gives Hindi its words for fragrance, good fortune and easy to reach; a cousin of the Greek eu in euphoria
example: सुगंधः इति पदे सु- शोभनं गन्धं दर्शयति। — In sugandha, su- marks a pleasant smell.

hindi: सूक्ति — अच्छी तरह कही गई सीख-भरी बात
definition: a well-turned saying, a single witty or wise verse quoted on its own, from सु, well, and भाषित, spoken, the same root as Hindi भाषा (neuter)
example: गुरुः प्रतिदिनम् एकम् सुभाषितम् पठति। — Every day the teacher recites one wise verse.

hindi: सोना — पीली क़ीमती धातु
definition: gold, literally the one of good colour, a compound that Hindi wore down to सोना, the common word for the metal (neuter a-stem)
example: राज्ञः मुकुटं सुवर्णस्य अस्ति। — The king's crown is of gold.

hindi: सुनार — सोने के गहने बनाने वाला
definition: a goldsmith, literally the gold-maker, a compound that Hindi wore down to सुनार, the jeweller of every bazaar (masculine a-stem)
example: सुवर्णकारः कंकणं करोति। — The goldsmith makes a bangle.

hindi: सूत — कपास का धागा
definition: a thread or string, which Hindi wore down to सूत for cotton yarn, keeping सूत्र for a formula or rule (neuter a-stem; from √सिव्, to sew)
example: सूत्रेण माला ग्रथ्यते। — A garland is strung on a thread.

hindi: मंच-संचालक — नाटक का आरंभ करने वाला; हिंदी में अब पर्दे के पीछे का कर्ताधर्ता
definition: literally thread-holder, the stage manager who opens a Sanskrit play and introduces it, whom Hindi recast as the hidden mastermind behind events (masculine noun)
example: सूत्रधारः नाटकस्य आरंभं करोति — The stage manager opens the play.

hindi: सूरज — दिन का तारा
definition: the sun, whose final cluster Hindi broke apart and rounded off, producing the everyday word सूरज (masculine a-stem)
example: सूर्यः प्रातः उदेति। — The sun rises in the morning.

hindi: थाना — पुलिस चौकी, मूल अर्थ ठहरने की जगह
definition: place or standing ground; a cousin of English stand, station and state, and of Persian -stan as in Hindustan (from √स्था, to stand)
example: इदं स्थानं रमणीयम् अस्ति — This place is lovely.

hindi: तेल — चिकनाई, घी; हिंदी में अब केवल प्यार-दुलार
definition: oil, grease or any unctuous fat, the stickiness that binds, and only figuratively affection, which is all Hindi kept (masculine noun, from √स्निह्, to be sticky)
example: दीपे स्नेहः नास्ति — There is no oil in the lamp.

hindi: सपना — सोते समय दिखने वाला दृश्य
definition: a dream or sleep, which Hindi opened up with an extra vowel into सपना; Greek hypnos and Latin somnus are cousins (masculine a-stem)
example: रात्रौ मया स्वप्नः दृष्टः। — I saw a dream at night.

hindi: बहन — सगी बहिन
definition: sister; a cousin of English sister and Latin soror, the source of sorority, though everyday Hindi switched to बहन (stem स्वसृ)
example: मम स्वसा गीतं गायति — My sister sings a song.

hindi: कल्याण — 'भला हो' कहने वाली शुभकामना
definition: well-being or good fortune, also spoken as a blessing meaning 'may it be well' (from सु, well, + अस्ति, it is); the lucky mark स्वस्तिक is named after it
example: राजा प्रजाभ्यः स्वस्ति इति कामयते। — The king wishes well-being to his people.

hindi: अभिनंदन — आने वाले का आदर से सत्कार
definition: a welcome, built exactly like English 'well-come': सु, well, plus आगत, having come; Hindi keeps it whole in स्वागत है and स्वागत-कक्ष
example: आचार्यः नूतनान् छात्रान् स्वागतम् इति वदति। — The teacher says welcome to the new students.

hindi: भस्म हो जाना — सब कुछ खत्म या बर्बाद होना
definition: in Hindu ritual, the call spoken as each offering is poured into the fire; Hindi turned it into an idiom, सब स्वाहा, for money or goods burnt up and gone
example: पुरोहितः अग्नौ घृतम् जुहोति, स्वाहा इति च वदति। — The priest pours ghee into the fire and says svaha.

hindi: हल्दी — पीला मसाला
definition: turmeric, the yellow root, which Hindi wore down to हल्दी, the spice in almost every Indian curry (feminine ā-stem)
example: भोजने हरिद्रा मिश्रिता अस्ति। — Turmeric is mixed in the food.

hindi: हाथ — बाँह का आगे का भाग
definition: the hand, which Hindi rubbed down to हाथ while keeping हस्त for formal words like हस्ताक्षर, a signature, literally a hand-letter (masculine a-stem)
example: बालकः हस्तम् उन्नमयति। — The boy raises his hand.

hindi: हिया — दिल, मन (कविता और गीतों में)
definition: heart, the organ and the seat of feeling; a cousin of English heart and Greek kardia, source of cardiac (built on हृद्)
example: मातुः हृदयं कोमलम् अस्ति — A mother's heart is tender.

hindi: जाड़ा — अगहन-पूस की, ठंड की शुरुआत वाली ऋतु
definition: early winter, the season of Margashirsha and Pausha when the first cold sets in; its हेम- is a cousin of हिम, snow, and of Latin hiems, winter (masculine)
example: हेमंत ऋतौ क्षेत्रेषु धान्यं पच्यते। — In early winter the grain ripens in the fields.
